title: Song - Immortal, Invisible (simplified)
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: Immortal, Invisible in G major and 3/4, with a one-beat pickup, over one held block chord a bar in the left (G, C, D).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1291-st-denio: St. Denio (hymntune: Immortal, Invisible), SATB, sounding G major; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1291)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1291), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Simplified: one block chord a bar, held, with the three primary chords only (G, C, D), instead of the full version's moving left hand.
Slower: 88 instead of 104 quarter notes a minute.
